input.instruction: Complete a two-part change request. Disposition reflects readiness to add the insured person versus register the interested party. Use accepted_named_insured_quote in missing_fields while exact quote/date/premium acceptance required for the insured change is absent; the notice request is independent. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: Please add Milo Vale, my roommate, as an insured person on October 20, 2026. Also add our landlord Mara Vale for proof notices.
Milo and Mara share a surname. Are they the same person or should both be insured?
Different people. Only Milo should become an insured person. Mara is the landlord and should just receive notices at mara.vale@leasing.example.
Have you received and accepted a quote that includes Milo, the October 20 date, and a premium?
No quote yet. I want Milo added, but I cannot accept an unknown premium. Get me the quote first.
Should the landlord-notice request wait for that quote, or do you authorize it separately?
Handle the notices separately. I confirm Mara Vale at mara.vale@leasing.example for interested-party notices. Do not make her insured or treat this as acceptance of Milo's quote.

requested_new_named_insured.description: Person requested for a quoted named-insured addition, copied exactly.

named_insured_requested_date.description: Requested effective date for the insured-person quote.

named_insured_quote_accepted.description: True for exact quote/date/premium acceptance; false if expressly not accepted.

interested_party_name.description: Person confirmed for notices only, copied exactly.

interested_party_email.description: Confirmed email destination for interested-party notices.

interested_party_request_confirmed.description: Whether name, destination, and independent notice request are explicitly confirmed by the authorized customer.

same_person.description: True only if the conversation establishes the two names refer to one person; false if explicitly different.
